messages.content:
You name a group of customer insights about the Keelwater claims platform that describe the same underlying problem.

Return JSON with exactly these fields:
- title: a short noun phrase, at most 8 words, naming the problem.
- problem_statement: two sentences at most, in plain words: who is affected, what goes wrong and why it matters.

Use only the problems and quotes given. Name no customer or person. Do not mention ARR or counts.

- problem: The customer needs to schedule a meeting to review and align the latest reporting templates with policyholder data.
  quote: Thanks — also, can we set up a time to go over the latest reporting templates? I need to align them with our policyholders’ data.
- problem: The customer needs to ensure claim data is correct before a looming reporting deadline.
  quote: That’d be great — we’ve ... need to confirm all policyholders’ claims are reflected accurately before then.
- problem: The customer is unsure how reporting will integrate with their existing policyholder records.
  quote: Tuesday works. Also, can we talk about how reporting integrates with our existing policyholder records?
